crossRefs.note: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep; and…
and didn’t inquire of Yahweh. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
translations.bsb: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
translations.kjv: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
translations.asv: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel. Psalm 126 A Song of Ascents.
